status_detail: Project web-app has 2 secret-like environment variables stored as plain text.

finding_info.title: Vercel project has no secret-like environment variables stored as plain text
finding_info.desc: Secret-like environment variables stored as plain text are readable by anyone with project access and were the April 2026 breach class.

remediation.desc: Re-create the environment variables with the Sensitive type so their values are encrypted.

status_detail: Project web-app has directory listing disabled.

finding_info.title: Vercel project has directory listing disabled
finding_info.desc: Directory listing exposes the file structure of deployments.

status_detail: The firewall configuration endpoint is not accessible with the provided token; verify the Web Application Firewall manually.

finding_info.title: Vercel project has the Web Application Firewall enabled
finding_info.desc: Without the WAF, deployments have no managed protection against common attacks.

remediation.desc: Enable the Web Application Firewall for the project in the Vercel dashboard.

status_detail: Team acme has 5 of 6 members with the owner role.

finding_info.title: Vercel team follows least privilege with a limited number of owner roles
finding_info.desc: Over-broad owner roles widen the blast radius of any compromised member account.

remediation.desc: Downgrade members who do not need the owner role to member or viewer.
